raw_text: THREAD: A video circulating on Pakistani Twitter claims to show an IAF pilot making political statements against the Indian government. This is FAKE. Analysis: 1) Lip sync is off by ~200ms (typical of deepfake generation). 2) Facial texture around jawline shows smoothing artefacts. 3) Background is from a 2019 press conference (reverse image match). 4) Audio spectrogram shows splicing at 0:14 and 0:38. 5) No official IAF channels have shared this. Assessment: Likely generated using face-swap AI, distributed to influence Indian elections. First appeared on ISPR-adjacent accounts.
